item.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, today has approved the development of the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum (YYBM) at the North and South Block Complex, New Delhi, at an estimated total project cost of ₹3,230 crore , as appraised by the Public Investment Board (PIB).
item.title: Cabinet approves Development of Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at North and South Block Complex, New Delhi
